required_behavior: Permit different local models and require explicit translation at contacts.
unsafe_claim: Every important noun should have one enterprise-wide meaning.

required_behavior: Split contexts only for model applicability; place several cohesive libraries in one context when language and ownership remain unified.
unsafe_claim: Every reusable library deserves its own bounded context.

required_behavior: Model product adoption and outcomes independently, then map it to one or more owned/imported contexts.
unsafe_claim: Every product is exactly one bounded context.

required_behavior: Retain supporting contexts that have no independent user promise or exit boundary.
unsafe_claim: Every bounded context must be sold or operated as a product.

required_behavior: Use aggregate boundaries only for synchronous invariants and transactional consistency.
unsafe_claim: Every aggregate is a service or deployment.

required_behavior: Require language, rules, authority and change evidence; record implementation layout separately.
unsafe_claim: Repository, crate, microservice or team boundaries prove the domain seam.

required_behavior: Decompose packaging into independently owned promises, models, capabilities and providers.
unsafe_claim: A vendor SKU or open-source project proves one product and one model.

required_behavior: Translate source occurrences into each context's model without transferring source authority.
unsafe_claim: Contexts sharing source data must share one canonical model.

required_behavior: Preserve whole concepts and conceptual contours; expose stable operations rather than fragments clients must reconstruct.
unsafe_claim: Potential reuse requires the smallest possible libraries and contexts.

required_behavior: Merge, narrow or translate any candidates that claim the same meaning regardless of numeric score.
unsafe_claim: A product split score may override duplicate semantic ownership.

required_behavior: Treat it as discovery evidence and test it against language, invariants, authority and real scenarios.
unsafe_claim: An EventStorming cluster is a ratified bounded context or aggregate.

required_behavior: Version the bounded verdict and continuously refactor toward deeper insight from implementation and domain evidence.
unsafe_claim: DDD produces a complete upfront ontology that should stop changing.
